description: Metro de la 80 works: two lanes closed on Avenida 80 from 7:00 to 17:00, detour via Carrera 76 and Calle 33.
decision_reason: There are HIGH alerts, but they can be mitigated; the mitigations become conditions.

alerts.because: The closure removes a Metroplús or feeder bus stop and there is no alternative stop within 300 m.
Heavy detour traffic near a school at entry or exit time raises child pedestrian risk.
The detour adds more than 10 minutes to a bus route on the corridor.

recommendations: Install a temporary bus stop within 300 m
Coordinate a temporary route change with the bus operator
Ban heavy vehicles on the detour during school entry and exit

questions_asked.question: Will heavy vehicles (trucks, buses) use the detour?
